description: This file defines an abstract class 'ModelFormAction' and nested classes for handling form actions in the OFBiz framework, including reading sub-actions, modeling call-to-action elements, and executing services.

classes.name: ModelFormAction
classes.description: Abstract class representing a form action with static method to read sub-actions and nested classes for specific actions.

classes.name: ModelFormAction.CallParentActions
classes.description: Models the <call-parent-actions> element, executing actions from a parent form based on context.

classes.name: ModelFormAction.Service
classes.description: Models the <service> element, encapsulating logic to invoke a service with parameters and handle results.

methods.name: readSubActions
methods.description: Reads sub-actions from an XML element, creating appropriate action instances based on node names.
